title: A Long Term, Safety Study of Apricitabine in HIV-infected Subjects
brief_summary: The study will examine how safe and effective apricitabine is when given long term (as ongoing treatment) to HIV patients who have already completed the AVX-201 trial
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Completed AVX-201 protocol, Plasma HIV RNA \<5000 copies/ml, CD4 cells \>50

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding females, withdrawal from AVX-201
